thesis: The speakers argue that the original promise of lending 1.0 platforms to democratize yield and lower default rates largely failed because competition drove up origination costs and most data points used did not provide meaningful predictive signal. They identify the viable opportunity in early-stage lending companies that use unique technology to observe previously unseen data points, thereby creating new credit products with high barriers to entry that prevent competitors from replicating their success.
